### Keeping Our Mouths in Check (Matthew 15:11) - Your Daily Bible Verse - December 30
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-december-30.html
Passage: Matthew 15:11
Points:
- Jesus gathered the multitude to emphasize that what comes out of the mouth defiles a person, not what enters it.
- Modern culture often obsesses over diets and health trends while ignoring the moral weight of speech.
- Believers deceive themselves if they claim to follow God without keeping control over their tongues.
- Words possess the power of life and death, requiring Christians to be far more vigilant about speech than food.

### Evil in Heart
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/evil-heart
Passage: Mark 7:20-23
Points:
- Jesus challenged shallow definitions of righteousness that treat sin as merely an external act.
- Sinful behavior begins inside, making the human heart the actual source of all moral defilement.
- Outward rituals and dietary distinctions possess no power to alter or purify an unclean heart.
- Genuine godliness requires inner cleansing and renewal through the Holy Spirit rather than external rule-keeping.
